from pyspark.sql.types import StructType, StructField, StringType, TimestampType, DoubleType
from pyspark.sql.functions import current_timestamp, input_file_name

# Caminho origem e destino
path_raw_wh = 'abfss://telemetria@stlogitrackdevbrazsouth.dfs.core.windows.net/warehouse/1. RAW'
path_bronze_wh = 'abfss://telemetria@stlogitrackdevbrazsouth.dfs.core.windows.net/warehouse/2. BRONZE'

# Criar df da origem
schema_wh = StructType([

   StructField('sensor_type', StringType(), True), 
   StructField('warehouse_id', StringType(), True), 
   StructField('temperature', DoubleType(), True), 
   StructField('humidity', DoubleType(), True), 
   StructField('timestamp', TimestampType(), True)])

df_raw_wh = (
     spark.read.format("parquet")
    .schema(schema_wh)
    .load(path_raw_wh)
)

# Criar df para o destino com 2 colunas de controle
df_bronze_wh = (
    df_raw_wh
    .withColumn("data_ingestao", current_timestamp())
    .withColumn("arquivo_origem", input_file_name())
)

# Enviar os dados da raw para bronze usando partição e criando tabelas delta
(df_bronze_wh.write
.format("delta")
.mode("append")
.partitionBy("warehouse_id")
.save(path_bronze_wh)
)
